plugins.name: travel-agent
plugins.description: Plan a trip end to end. Dispatches ~10 research subagents, harvests travel editorial (Conde Nast Traveler, NYT 36 Hours, Eater, Michelin), then builds a Word itinerary, per-city site guides, editorial guides, layered Google Maps import CSVs, and a reservation tracker. Every place carries operating hours, a reservation lead-time tag, and closure flags.
